answer: Yes. Summit Auto Lease lets us buy out your lease, so we can request the dealer payoff quote for you. Just sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1. This is the lease form, not NW-LPA-1, which is only for loans. Note that the dealer payoff quote can be different from the payoff Summit gives you directly. If our offer is higher than the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference (your lease equity) to you. If our offer is lower, you pay the difference at the appointment.
